notes: DocumentsPage contains inline administrator operation chrome but no standalone SourceOperationPanel.
React parity uses a test-local presentational harness with synthetic lifecycle labels only.
The fixture and harness make no backend, authorization, polling, retry, cancellation, or mutation claims.

geometry.layout: compact feature panel with source label and ordered lifecycle rows
geometry.density: two-line lifecycle rows with visible text labels

expectedTokenGeometry: Source label is distinct from ordered Preparation and Index rows
Lifecycle state uses text and restrained status markers

r10.keyboardTouch: not applicable to this read-only presentational harness
r10.screenReader: named region and definition list expose lifecycle labels and stages
r10.reducedMotion: lifecycle presentation has no required animation
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: synthetic stages are visible text only
r10.zoom: ordered lifecycle labels wrap without relying on icons
r10.darkLight: harness renders in zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: panel uses a single wrapping column
